messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT — p99 latency spike detected for service=streaming-api region=us-west. p99=4.9s, p95=820ms, error-rate stable. Auto-page to #incidents.
Maya (infra): seeing it on dashboards too. tail latency for stream reads spiking, some streams stall for several seconds then recover.
Samira (eng-sre): Thanks — checking cache telemetry. prefix-cache hitrate dropped from 92% -> 36% around 3469994200. correlates with last deploy.
AJ (prod): customer impact looks limited to streaming endpoints (low-volume customers first). Not seeing 5xxs, just timeouts on client side for streaming chunk arrival.
Maya (infra): stack traces show requests hitting slowpath in paging code, increased disk reads on kv-store. suspect large cache miss storm after prefix-hash rollout.
Samira (eng-sre): I can confirm a prefix-hash config was rolled out at 3469994195 (deploy-bot: deploy successful).
deploy-bot: deploy finished: ref=refs/heads/prefixhash-v2 commit=ab12cd3 by @Maya (infra) at 3469994195
Taylor (oncall): I'm taking this. initial mitigation suggestion: revert prefix-hash rollout or enable legacy-salting fallback. Need quick rollback plan.
Maya (infra): rollback would be fastest. can we toggle routing to use old key-salting in front of cache? that would warm hitrate quickly.
Samira (eng-sre): quick commands to check hitrate: ```
# prometheus
rate(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m]) / rate(prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])
```
Samira (eng-sre): current raw numbers: requests=1.2M/5m, hits=430k/5m. heavy tail of cold prefixes.
AJ (prod): customer impact count: ~28 customers experiencing >3s delays over last 10m, one support ticket opened for a streaming glitch.
Taylor (oncall): mitigation steps in order: 1) enable legacy-salt fallback 2) throttle cold-prefetch to avoid stampede 3) roll back prefixhash if fallback fails. executing step 1 now.
Maya (infra): toggled legacy fallback in featureflags: `ff.toggle('prefixhash.v2.fallback', true)` — verifying.
Samira (eng-sre): after toggle, hitrate jumped to 68% within 90s. p99 down to 1.8s, p95 420ms. still higher than baseline but improved.
Taylor (oncall): good. keep monitoring for 10m. start preparing rollback playbook if not back to baseline.
AJ (prod): @support FYI: please hold customer comms, we're mitigating and will update in 30m.
Maya (infra): logs show sustained eviction pressure on cache shards 5-7. probable cause: new hash mapping redistributed hot prefixes to cold shards.
Samira (eng-sre): adding a short-term warmup: run batched prefetch for top 5k prefixes over the next 5m. command: ```
python tools/prefetch.py --prefix-file top5k.txt --concurrency 50
```
Taylor (oncall): launched prefetch job with concurrency 40 to avoid overload. starting to see gradual hitrate improvement.
Maya (infra): measuring p50/p95/p99: baseline p99 pre-incident ~600ms, p95 200ms. current p99 1.2s after fallback+prefetch.
Samira (eng-sre): root cause notes for postmortem: prefix-hash rollout changed key distribution; redistribution increased cache hot-shard concentration and evictions; insufficient canary traffic for streaming workloads.
AJ (prod): customer impact assessment: small subset (28 customers) intermittent degraded streaming quality, no data loss. SLOs: p99 SLO breached for 12m window. estimate error budget consumption ~3%.
Taylor (oncall): timeline note for handoff: incident opened 3469994322, featureflag fallback enabled 3469994380, prefetch started 3469994445. Next oncall @Samira taking at 3469994680.
Samira (eng-sre): taking handoff at 3469994680. follow-ups: schedule controlled re-rollout with staggered mapping, add canary for streaming traffic, increase cache telemetry alert thresholds, create synthetic streaming checks to detect prefix-related degradations.
Maya (infra): I will draft a hotfix and rollback playbook. also recommend we add a pre-deploy shard-redistribution simulator for future prefix-hash changes.
Taylor (oncall): closing live bridge — moving to postmortem thread. leaving notes in incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0423-1. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated: p99 reduced to 860ms, incident categorized as SEV2, postmortem required.
